svg.title: Orion constellation — Stjörnumerkið Óríon
svg.desc: Seven principal stars form Orion’s two shoulders, three-star belt and two feet, joined with sparse guide lines.
svg.metadata: {"collection":"UteamUP Sectors and Nature","subject":"space-orion-constellation","label_en":"Orion constellation","label_is":"Stjörnumerkið Óríon","section":"16","category_en":"Space, astronomy and exploration","category_is":"Geimurinn, stjörnufræði og geimrannsóknir","batch":8,"tags":["space","constellation"],"description":"Seven principal stars form Orion’s two shoulders, three-star belt and two feet, joined with sparse guide lines.","design_note":"The observer-view arrangement places Betelgeuse upper left and Rigel lower right, with a sloping three-star belt between them.","style":{"viewBox":[0,0,24,24],"stroke":"#1655A6","stroke_width":0.9,"fill":"none","background":"transparent"}}
